fullstack.title: FullStack Development
fullstack.desc: I design complete, high-performance, and scalable web applications using Symfony for the backend and modern frameworks like VueJS or NuxtJs for the frontend.

frontend.title: Frontend Expertise
frontend.desc: Specialist in developing rich and responsive interfaces. I master the JavaScript ecosystem (Vue 3, ES6+) and CSS preprocessors (Sass) for optimal UX.

api.title: API Development
api.desc: Design and implementation of robust RESTful APIs with API Platform. Secure and documented architecture to facilitate integration with frontend clients.

agile.title: Agile Methodologies
agile.desc: Accustomed to Scrum/Agile environments. I actively participate in rituals (Sprint Planning, Daily, Retro) to ensure iterative and quality delivery.
